email.body1:
Kristine, saw SIS took top spot in the 2026 Best in KLAS for ASC solutions and just debuted SIS Scribe at ASCA.

Momentum like that usually opens more surgery-center accounts than a regional team can work before they cool off, and that is where deals quietly slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for SIS off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kristine, quick follow-up for SIS.

A category-leading award pulls in interest fast, but most teams cannot tell exactly how many meetings they need to convert that attention into closed ASC business this quarter. The gap shows up late, and recovering a quarter is far harder than planning one.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings SIS needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Kristine, last bit of proof for SIS.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. Running our AI SDR, they hit $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to similar health-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kristine, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling surgery-center pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority right now, no problem at all. Coming off a KLAS win and a product launch, I know your calendar is its own kind of full.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an ASC sales motion? I will tailor it to SIS either way.
